entities.name: Query protein 424 aa
observations: Sequence length is 424 residues; estimated molecular mass is 48.44 kDa.
Predicted theoretical pI is 9.09 with positive charge at neutral pH; no transmembrane segment or signal peptide was reported.
Pfam detects Aminotran_5 (PF00266) at residues 41–384 and KYNU_C (PF22580) at residues 331–418.
The sequence has strong homology to reviewed bacterial kynureninases, with 51.2–55.7% identity and approximately 97–99% coverage.
Functional assignment is moderate-confidence homology support rather than direct experimental characterization.

entities.name: Bacterial kynureninase
observations: Reviewed homologs Q1DDU5, Q1ITW5, and A6H1P7 are annotated as kynureninases.
Kynureninase homologs use pyridoxal 5'-phosphate as cofactor and are annotated as homodimers.
The canonical reactions cleave L-kynurenine to anthranilate plus L-alanine, and 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine to 3-hydroxyanthranilate plus L-alanine.
The associated EC number is EC 3.7.1.3; homologs are linked to tryptophan catabolism and quinolinate/NAD+ biosynthesis.

entities.name: PLP-dependent enzyme signature
observations: The query contains the Aminotran_5 family domain and is homologous across nearly its full length to PLP-dependent kynureninases.
A conserved lysine corresponding to the PLP-linked catalytic lysine is reported in homologs near residue 248; exact functional residue mapping to the query is not experimentally established.
